name: Young Democratic Socialists of America at NC State
description: YDSA at NC State is a youth chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA). We are a leftist organization that aims to educate and organize the NC State and greater Raleigh community.

name: YWAM Campus Fellowship
description: We work to help individuals develop a biblical worldview by exploring how Scripture applies to every aspect of life. We also teach apologetics and how to explain the Christian faith. This is a safe place to ask every deep question that you might have.

name: ZamoPack Association of Zamorano Alumni at North Carolina State University
description: This student organization serves as the North Carolina–based chapter of the Association of Zamorano Alumni in the United States (AGEAP-USA).

name: Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. the Mu Xi Chapter
description: The purpose of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Incorporated is to embrace Scholarship, provide true Service, set a standard for Sisterly Love and define the noble concept of Finer Womanhood.

name: Zeta Tau Alpha
description: ZTA sisterhood begins in college and extends far beyond four years. At Iota Phi, we are proud to be both a part of the Wolfpack and North Carolina Zetas! Since 1989, we have been home to some of the brightest and most wonderful women at North Carolina!

name: Zoology Club
description: The purpose of this club is to advocate for animals in a changing world, promote the general studies of animals and the environments in which they inhabit, and to provide information about the possible applications of a degree in Zoology.
